sections.title: Modeling and viewports
changes: Use geometry at different heights to define a rotation angle while preserving the locked rotation plane and snapping options.
Fix Ctrl toggling Move copies in the browser, including Linux; use /5 or *5 after placing a copy to divide or repeat it.
Append new viewports to the end of the tab list.

sections.title: Workspace
changes: Use normal scrolling in the left toolbar when the tools do not all fit; otherwise use the wheel to switch tools.
Show only the green insertion indicator when joining an existing inspector area, reserving the area highlight for new splits.
Expand inspector split targets to 15 pixels and double automatic scrolling speed while dragging sections.
Remove individual entries from Recent Projects without deleting their files.

sections.title: Releases and forks
changes: Use the building repository for desktop update feeds, including fork releases and local GitHub origin remotes.
Resolve website repository links from the publishing repository and synchronize README links for forks and custom Pages domains.
Use the same current screenshot in the README, website, and sharing previews.

title: Clearer Move snapping and faster tool navigation

sections.title: Move and snapping
changes: Automatically show unselected geometry in X-Ray while Move has a selection, whether selected before or after activating the tool.
Snap moving geometry to corners behind faces, including intermediate corners of recesses created with Push Pull.

sections.title: Workspace
changes: Use the mouse wheel over the left toolbar to select the previous or next tool, keeping remembered tool choices.

sections.title: Modeling and rotation
changes: Rotate selected geometry with the new Rotate tool below Move, using Q by default or a custom shortcut.
Choose a pivot on or away from the selection, set a reference point, and preview the rotation with geometry and grid snapping. Use arrow keys to lock the rotation plane.
Enter precise angles or formulas in the selected angle unit, or specify degrees, radians, or gradians explicitly. Rotation supports undo and redo.
Preserve rotated component orientations through shared edits, scaling, reflection, copying, and project reloads.

sections.title: Workspace and preferences
changes: Remember the Rotate tool and its axis and plane locks across restarts, even without a model edit.
Keep existing custom keyboard shortcuts when adding Rotate, choosing an available shortcut if Q is already assigned.

sections.title: Properties and workspace
changes: Inspect selected edge lengths and face perimeters in Properties.
New inspector layouts place Properties first and Outliner second, both expanded, with other sections collapsed. Existing saved layouts and disclosure choices are preserved.
Add breathing room below Outliner contents for easier scrolling and selection.
Enable the grid and wood joinery display by default while preserving saved visibility choices.

sections.title: Wood joinery
changes: Show joinery icons, machining, and guides for the immediate children of the group being edited. Opening a board exposes its original stock geometry.
Restore the assembled joinery overview when returning to the model root, while preserving saved connections and fully assembled export geometry.

sections.title: Joinery and woodworking
changes: Create and edit wood joints and connections in dedicated inspector sections, with joint previews, machining diagnostics, and cut guides.
Apply stock materials to descendant parts, choose wood types with searchable selectors, and customize sanding grits.
Export time and cost estimates to PDF. All PDF reports now share a branded header with the project name and generation date.

sections.title: Projects, sharing, and file formats
changes: Save undo and redo history with projects and autosave, navigate document history, and access Undo and Redo from the app bar.
Reopen recent projects and use account, project-sharing, and real-time collaboration controls when an account server is configured.
Import STL and OBJ meshes and DXF profiles, and export STL files alongside the existing SketchUp import and OBJ export.
Preserve screenshot display settings, transparency, and framing when exporting images.

sections.title: Modeling and navigation
changes: Use consistent modeling anchors and combined snapping across drawing, transform, measurement, and text tools, with remembered axis and plane locks.
Improve drawing groups, extrusion, and offset behavior, keep scaling near the center stable at different zoom levels, and clean up duplicate geometry and aligned vertices.
Pan with two fingers and pinch to zoom on touch devices. Display group labels in the viewport and align section planes with the active axes.
Adjust section cuts with multi-axis handles and configure finite grid dimensions, fading grids, and sun-direction cues.

sections.title: Workspace and performance
changes: Remember dialog sizes and positions, resize from every edge and corner, and use searchable selectors and consistently centered inspector tables.
Refine Appearance and Color controls, tool highlighting, loading feedback, and inspector icons. Automatic Fasteners controls and previews are temporarily hidden.
Improve shadow boundaries, occlusion, and edge depth, and fade distant axes for clearer models.
Speed up viewport geometry and rendering with parallel work and caches for machining, joinery diagnostics, picking, and Outliner data. Enable per-viewport FPS diagnostics in Settings.
Send feature suggestions and issue reports from the app, with system diagnostics included in issue reports.

title: A customizable workspace and project estimates

sections.title: Workspace and settings
changes: Rearrange, dock, and float inspector panes, with independent scrolling and sticky section headers. Workspace layouts and control preferences are remembered across restarts.
Browse inspector information in full-width tables with aligned columns and remembered horizontal scrolling for wide catalogs.
Customize keyboard shortcuts in Settings and toggle the right sidebar with Tab.
Rename viewport tabs independently and restore saved project selections when reopening a project.

sections.title: Materials, finishes, and estimates
changes: Create reusable stock material and surface treatment catalogs, assign them to model parts, and retain material definitions when copying and pasting.
Generate cutting plans from assigned stock materials.
Estimate material costs and finishing time from model surfaces, with configurable prices, currency, treatment steps, and per-part overrides.

sections.title: Modeling and display
changes: Configure grid spacing and inference colors, and toggle edge and face snapping targets independently.
Use entity dimension gizmos and improved Push/Pull snapping for precise modeling.
The Outer Shell solid tool is now called Combine.
Improved dialog focus and cached scene meshes, Outliner data, and solid measurements for a smoother workspace.

sections.title: Views and navigation
changes: Work with multiple viewport tabs and resizable split views, each with its own camera and a shared model, selection, and undo history.
Use the interactive compass to switch camera views, with viewport layouts and camera preferences remembered across restarts.
The grid stays anchored to the model while orbiting, and viewports use a cleaner borderless appearance.
Docking a viewport keeps the correct pane active so camera navigation affects the intended view.

sections.title: Measurements and drawing
changes: Choose length, area, volume, and angle units with independent decimal precision in the new Units sidebar section. These preferences persist across restarts, and lengths entered without a unit use the selected length unit.
Enable Snap to grid to align drawing and placement with the grid spacing at the current zoom; the setting is remembered across restarts.
Line drawing stops automatically when a closed shape creates a face, and completed shapes clear their drawing guides.
Shape previews stay on their starting face during local-axis snapping and remain stable when following tilted reference points.
Solids with inset recesses now report their volume correctly and remain usable by solid tools.

sections.title: Workshop plans
changes: Cut lists use consistent part ordering and preserve width and cutting direction for short parts aligned with other parts in the same group.
Cut lists and cutting layouts show clearer metric dimensions in millimeters or centimeters.

title: Choose where browser projects are saved

sections.title: Browser saving
changes: Save and Save As now let you choose a filename and location in supported browsers, remembering the last save directory and updating the model name after the file is written.
Browsers without file-system picker support continue to download project files using their download settings.
Cancelling the save picker leaves the project unchanged, and failed writes report an error without marking the project as saved.

sections.title: Editor
changes: Starting a new project resets the camera angle and framing while preserving projection and field-of-view preferences.

sections.title: Plans and exports
changes: Generate woodworking cut lists and suggested board or sheet layouts as PDFs, using selected parts or the whole visible project.
Export current and standard camera views as PNG, WebP, or PDF, with previews, paper sizes, resolution choices, and combined or separate views.

sections.title: Modeling and annotations
changes: Attach editable text labels to model geometry, with labels following their attachment as the model changes.
Paint individual faces or all faces in a group or component, and see paint colors in Outliner icons.
Inset Push/Pull operations now leave recesses open instead of covering them with the original face.
Dimensions and text labels respect geometry depth, and orbiting uses visible geometry for more natural pivots.

sections.title: Editor and preferences
changes: Search objects and control their visibility directly in the Outliner.
Tool choices, polygon sides, Move copy mode, axis locks, snapping options, group emphasis, searches, and export settings now persist across restarts.
Sidebars and the Outliner remember their scroll positions across restarts.
Dialogs use consistent layouts and action placement, grid contrast is tuned for light and dark themes, and context-menu checkboxes respond across the full row.
Offset now uses the F shortcut; Fit view remains available from its toolbar button.

title: More ways to view and align your models

sections.title: Viewing and drawing
changes: Switch between perspective and parallel projection, choose standard camera views, and adjust the field of view from the new View sidebar section.
Camera view preferences and the new sidebar sections persist across sessions.
Draw lines with improved axis alignment guides and toggle axis or plane locks from the toolbar.

sections.title: Editor
changes: Browse release history offline from Help → Release notes, with new notes opening automatically once per release.
Use the Edit menu for shared selection commands, and expand or collapse an object's descendants from the Outliner context menu.
Identify Outliner entities with clearer icons and labels, and read keyboard shortcuts in a cleaner layout.

sections.title: Browser
changes: App keyboard shortcuts now prevent conflicting browser actions while preserving clipboard commands and text entry.
The loading screen follows your saved theme or system color scheme.

sections.title: Editor
changes: Use shared context menus in the viewport and Outliner to work with objects and selections.
Drag and drop Outliner entries to reorganize groups and components.
Inspector preferences, section order, and docked or floating layouts now persist across sessions.

sections.title: Modeling
changes: Solid tools support planar intersections and nested component operands.

title: Precision drawing and a more capable editor

sections.title: Drawing and modeling
changes: Enter precise measurements and use improved axis snapping and 3D inference.
Lock drawing planes while creating shapes.
Erase faces as well as edges, with improved dimension behavior.

sections.title: Editor
changes: Find entities in the Outliner and commands in searchable keyboard shortcut help.
Switch to a dark theme with matching tool icons, clearer cursors, and improved face previews and shadows.
Opened projects use their file names, with clearer autosave recovery messages.
Try the browser editor from the new KetchUp website.

sections.title: Create and organize
changes: Draw edges and planar faces with Line, Rectangle, Circle, Polygon, and Freehand tools and geometry snapping.
Shape geometry with Push/Pull, Scale, Offset, Move, Paint, and solid tools.
Measure models with Tape Measure, Protractor, and Dimensions.
Organize models with groups and components, a geometry clipboard, and undo and redo.

sections.title: Files and platforms
changes: Save portable .ketchup projects with local autosave, import SketchUp .skp geometry, and export Wavefront .obj files.
Run the editor on Windows, macOS, Linux, or in a desktop browser.
